items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And my mother's name was Magdalen.

ctx.x: Well, before you go into grade school, Foots, I want to know your father's name and your mother's name.
My father's name was Joseph Thomas. And my mother's name was Magdalen. I'd always known it as Maggie, but it was Magdalen.
